name: Vitaliy Sergeyevich Andreyev

attribution.legal_posture: Russian national and financial facilitator sanctioned for support to Chinyong Information Technology Cooperation Company; administrative sanctions designation; criminal charge or conviction is outside this designation.

caveats: The formal Latin and Cyrillic name forms are official primary-name renderings relative to the catalog display name; Russia is coarse designation context, while present location, account, wallet, exchange and transaction control require separate evidence.

sources.support: Treasury identifies Andreyev as a Russian national facilitating payments to Chinyong, reports that since at least December 2024 he worked with Kim Ung Sun to facilitate multiple transfers totaling nearly $600,000 by converting cryptocurrency to U.S.-dollar cash, and records his E.O. 13687 designation. These are administrative-source findings, not adjudicated facts; no wallet, exchange, bank, account, transaction, or payment selector is retained

Birth, birthplace, nationality, citizenship, gender, tax, wallet, compliance, and other sensitive fields are excluded
